title: A class box: name, fields, methods — with visibility on every member
caption: Stereotypes go above the name: «abstract» (name in italics), «interface», «enumeration». Show only the members that matter for the design.

steps.text: Three compartments: the header (stereotype + name), the fields, then the methods. «abstract» means it can't be instantiated, and its name is set in italics.
Every member starts with its visibility: - private (id, balance), # protected (status, _check: for subclasses), + public (deposit, withdraw). The public methods are the class's contract.
«interface»: only method signatures, no fields and no state. Classes implement it.
«enumeration»: a closed set of values, listed plainly in the fields compartment and with no visibility.
